item.title: U.S. military destroys 5 Iranian oil tankers. And, the Smithsonian head resigns
item.description: The U.S. military says it has destroyed five Iranian oil tankers as the conflict continues to escalate. And, Smithsonian head Lonnie G. Bunch III says he plans to step down by the end of the year.
item.content:encoded:

(Image credit: Tasos Katopodis)

item.title: Cargo jet tried to abort unsteady landing before Miami crash, flight data indicates
item.description: Flight data suggest an Amazon cargo plane tried to abort an unsteady landing at Miami International Airport before smashing into a van and killing five people inside, according to information investigators released Tuesday.
item.content:encoded:
Flight data suggest an Amazon cargo plane tried to abort an unsteady landing at Miami International Airport before smashing into a van and killing five people inside, according to information investigators released Tuesday.

(Image credit: David Santiago)

item.title: National Guard member arrested in DC, accused of drawing gun on fellow Guard member
item.description: A member of the Georgia National Guard deployed in Washington, D.C., as part of a task force to fight crime, has been arrested for pulling a gun on a fellow Guard member in an alleged dispute over regulation haircuts.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: COMIC: If we fight, is our love doomed? And other honest questions about conflict
item.description: Arguing with a partner or a loved one can be anxiety-inducing. Conflict resolution facilitator Priya Parker explains how to start and end a fight — while easing dread for everyone.

item.title: Mail-in voters weigh flying to vote in person and other backup plans amid uncertainty
item.description: Voters and election officials are navigating uncertainty about mail-in voting for the midterms as the legal fight drags on over the U.S. Postal Service plan for President Trump's bid for restrictions.

item.title: Judges may face unprecedented decisions this election. A new guide seeks to help
item.description: The idea of law enforcement taking possession of ballots in the middle of an active election used to be considered impossible. Now, it's a scenario voting officials — and judges — are training for.

item.title: Citing the 'Deep State,' Trump overhauls the intelligence community
item.description: The catastrophic 9/11 attacks forced the intelligence community to radically revamp its ways of doing business. Now, critics say, President Trump is dismantling much of what was built since then.

item.title: Republicans kick off a 'Trumpapalooza' of a midterm convention Wednesday in Texas
item.description: Republicans have never held a midterm convention before. But there's also never been a president like Donald Trump. Billed as a "Trumpapalooza," the unprecedented event kicks of in Dallas Wednesday.
